name: ingram_micro-mcp
description: Ingram Micro (Xvantage / Developer Portal) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, qu

platform_mcp_ingram_micro_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_ingram_micro_client_id.description: Client ID (Consumer Key) of your app on developer.ingrammicro.com (My Apps); production keys after app approval.

platform_mcp_ingram_micro_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_ingram_micro_client_secret.description: Client Secret of the same app; exchanged for a bearer token at /oauth/oauth30/token (client_credentials).

platform_mcp_ingram_micro_customer_numbe.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CUSTOMER_NUMBER
platform_mcp_ingram_micro_customer_numbe.description: Your Ingram Micro reseller customer number (IM-CustomerNumber header, e.g. 20-222222).

platform_mcp_ingram_micro_country_code.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_COUNTRY_CODE
platform_mcp_ingram_micro_country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country of your Ingram Micro account (IM-CountryCode header, e.g. US).

platform_mcp_ingram_micro_sender_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_SENDER_ID
platform_mcp_ingram_micro_sender_id.description: Optional sender identification text (IM-SenderID header, max 32 chars).

platform_mcp_ingram_micro_customer_conta.title: PLATFORM_MCP_INGRAM_MICRO_CUSTOMER_CONTACT
platform_mcp_ingram_micro_customer_conta.description: E-mail of the logged-in user (IM-CustomerContact header); required by Freight Estimate (quote_shipping).

tools.name: me
tools.description: No account endpoint; the probe runs a one-row Product Search (GET /resellers/v6/catalog). `sign` is used only to stamp every request with a fresh 32-hex IM-CorrelationID ('Unique transaction number to identify each transaction', maxLength 32); nothing is signed.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Search Products (GET /resellers/v6/catalog): keyword = Ingram part number, vendor part number, title or vendor name; category e.g. 'Displays'; max 100 per page. Search returns no price — use get_product for details (price & availability is POST /resellers/v6/catalog/priceandavailability).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Product Details (GET /resellers/v6/catalog/details/{ingramPartNumber}, 6-char Ingram part number): description, vendor, category, indicators, dimensions and weights in `raw`; no price.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Freight Estimate (POST /resellers/v6/freightestimate) for one Ingram part number to a destination country; one option per ship-from branch with its default carrier (shipVia, freightRate, transitDays) and the alternative carriers in `carriers`. Needs the customer_contact config field (IM-CustomerContact header). Currency is freightEstimateResponse.currencyCode in `raw`.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create your Order v6 (POST /resellers/v6/orders). Pass `items` in Ingram form [{customerLineNumber, ingramPartNumber, quantity}] and `shipping_address` as shipToInfo {contact, companyName, addressLine1, addressLine2, city, state, postalCode, countryCode, phoneNumber, email}; `shipping_option` is a carrier code from quote_shipping. The required customerOrderNumber (max 18) is generated as MCP+yyMMddHHmmss (UTC). Orders are placed on your credit account.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get Order Details v6.1 (GET /resellers/v6.1/orders/{ordernumber}, e.g. 20-RD3QV): orderStatus, totals, lines[] with lineStatus and shipmentDetails[].carrierDetails[].trackingDetails[] in `raw`; tracking_number is the first line's first parcel.

tools.name: track
tools.description: Order lines of Get Order Details v6.1 as shipment events: lineStatus plus the first shipment's carrier, tracking number/URL and shipped/delivered dates per line.
